notes.title: Gunkan Zero Pre-Alpha2.0 Live NOW
notes.notes:
[h2]New Pre-Alpha Version Available! 🎉[/h2]
Hey! In this update, I've made several changes and improvements to the pre-alpha you’ve already been testing. Most of them are visual adjustments, but there are also some major additions. Here are the most important updates:

[list]
[h3][*][b]🎮 Full Controller Support[/b][/h3]
The game now supports all types of controllers, and on-screen button prompts dynamically change depending on the controller you use:
🟦 [i]DualSense[/i]
🟩 [i]Xbox[/i]
🔴[i] Pro Controller[/i]

[h3][*] [b]🖥️ Revamped UI[/b][/h3]
[*] [b]📊 Level and experience indicators are now visible.[/b]
[*] [b]📜 Larger inventory menu for better readability.[/b]
[*] [b]🔥 New Affinity System[/b]
I’ve developed my own affinity system, which will impact combat mechanics. The characters now have improved animations.

[h3][*][b]🎭 Animaciones personalizadas[/b][/h3]
[*][b]🚶 Out-of-combat animations have been completely redesigned (yep, I finally made them myself![/b]
[*][b]⚔️ Combat animations have also been improved.[/b]
[*][b]🐛 Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed an issue that prevented aggressive enemies from attacking properly.
[*][b]📸 Camera Improvements[/b]
The camera now dynamically follows the player outside of combat for a better visual experience.

[h3][*][b]⚔️ Combat Adjustments[/b][/h3]
[*][b]❌ Removed the stun mechanic.[/b]
[*][b]⏳ Increased base time to improve battle flow.[/b]
[*][b]💥 New strong attack available when exploiting an enemy’s weakness.[/b]
[*][b]🗃️ Separate Inventories for Nobu and Ume[/b]
Now Ume and the player have individual inventories.
[/list]
[b]📌 Below, you’ll find a chart explaining how the new affinity system works.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42471226/0a0c4e1d5ad3b87f50c3d0b14d91e88d613e0753.png[/img]
Thanks for testing the pre-alpha and for all your support!

notes.title: Devlog #2 1/12
notes.notes:
In today's devlog, I want to inform you that I have been working on the animations for my game, as I mentioned in the first devlog. I believe I have learned to animate in Blender and, in addition, I am attaching a video of the walking animation I've progressed on so far for the protagonist. It has been challenging, and I have been dissatisfied with several previous attempts I've made until I reached this point, which shows the delay. Next week, I plan to keep practicing my animations and will continue sharing them. Also, as you can see, the 3D model used is one that I created for the protagonist of the game. Obviously, it is not the final model, as the hands, clothing, etc., are missing, but the base you see will be the one I continue to work on. Personally, I am concerned about the integration into Unity, and there are still several things I need to fix regarding the pre-alpha version of my game. Fortunately, I also want to share that now both combat characters will have access to the inventory, although it will be different. In the next version, you'll be able to see this change. As always, I would appreciate it if you could encourage wishlists for my game, and I am still thinking about a name for it.
